reason: Response 1 gives a four-engineer team with no security engineer a more practical, cheaper plan: a manifest-and-lockfile-only diff gate, proof that tests actually ran, a fleet-wide kill-switch drill and concrete fallbacks; Response 2 adds useful points (blocking merges to auto-deploy branches, cross-tenant leakage, legal review) but spends more on process overhead and misses the tests-actually-ran check.
